title: Design criteria.
officialText:
Alternate load path method and/or specific local resistance method for key elements shall conform to the
appropriate design criteria as determined from Sections 1616.9, 1616.10 and 1616.11. Load combinations for the alternate load
path method shall be as specified in Section 1605.5.
